source_note: Compiled from official notices and mainstream reporting. Every card links to its original source.

items.title: UAE Golden Visa open to graduates from top 100 universities
items.summary: International graduates from the world's top 100 universities are now eligible to apply for the UAE's 10-year Golden Visa residency programme. This offers long-term residency for qualified graduates seeking to live and work in the Emirates.

items.title: Canada publishes official cost of 10-year Super Visa
items.summary: Canada has officially announced the fee structure for its 10-year Super Visa programme, which allows parents and grandparents of Canadian residents to visit for extended periods. Applicants now have clarity on the costs involved.

items.title: US midterm results bring hope for Indian students, but visa worries remain
items.summary: The outcome of US midterm elections has created cautious optimism among Indian students, though concerns about visa policies persist. The political shift may influence future immigration decisions affecting student visa applicants from India.

items.title: Will Democratic Congress bring relief to Indian H-1B holders?
items.summary: Following the US midterm elections, questions arise about whether Democratic control of Congress could lead to changes benefiting Indian H-1B visa holders. The article examines potential immigration policy shifts under the new political landscape.

items.title: India-EU trade deal to ease mobility for Indian professionals
items.summary: A reported India-EU trade agreement is expected to improve mobility for Indian professionals working in Europe, though work visas will still be mandatory. The deal aims to facilitate easier movement while maintaining existing visa requirements.

items.title: Australia reviews tough student visa rules as universities face revenue loss
items.summary: Australia is reportedly reviewing its stricter student visa regulations after universities experienced financial losses. The review suggests possible changes to current visa policies that have affected international student enrolments and institutional income.

items.title: Australia introduces new biometric requirements for Indian student visa applicants
items.summary: Australia has introduced new biometric requirements for Indian students applying for visas in 2026. The change affects student visa applicants from India who will now need to provide biometric data as part of their application process.

items.title: Australia expands biometric requirements for visa applicants in India
items.summary: Australia has expanded biometric requirements for visa applicants in India. The new measures affect those applying for Australian visas from India, requiring additional biometric data collection as part of the application process.

items.title: Australia may require Indian students to deposit funds in local banks
items.summary: Australia's student visa rules could change to require Indian applicants to deposit funds in local Australian banks. The potential new requirement would affect how Indian students demonstrate financial capacity for their visa applications, though the change is not yet confirmed.

items.title: UK raises student visa financial requirement from November 30
items.summary: The UK is increasing the financial requirement for student visa applicants from November 30. Indian students planning to study in the UK will need to demonstrate higher funds to meet the new threshold for visa approval.

items.title: Could the SMARTER Act change how Indians get US Green Cards?
items.summary: The SMARTER Act, being discussed around the US midterm elections, could potentially change the green card process for Indians. The proposed legislation may affect how Indian applicants navigate the permanent residency pathway in the United States.

items.title: Number of active Indian students in US falls by 13.5% amid visa issues
items.summary: The number of active Indian students in the United States has dropped by 13.5 per cent, with visa issues cited as a contributing factor. The decline reflects challenges Indian students are facing in obtaining and maintaining US student visas.

items.title: Indian students reconsidering Canada due to job uncertainty and safety concerns
items.summary: Indian students are rethinking their education plans for Canada, citing job uncertainty and safety concerns. The shift in sentiment is affecting Canada's appeal as a study destination among Indian applicants.

items.title: Australia expands biometric requirements for visa applicants in India
items.summary: Australia has expanded biometric requirements for visa applicants applying from India. Students and other visa applicants will need to comply with new rules regarding biometric data submission. The changes affect those applying for Australian visas from India.

items.title: Number of active Indian students in US falls by 13.5% amid visa issues
items.summary: The number of active Indian students in the United States has declined by 13.5 percent. Visa issues are cited as a contributing factor to this significant drop in Indian student enrollment at US educational institutions.

items.title: Indian students cite visa issues, job prospects and safety for avoiding Canada
items.summary: Indian students are avoiding Canada due to visa issues, poor job prospects and safety concerns. The combination of these factors is making Canada a less attractive study destination for students from India compared to previous years.

items.title: New Zealand announces estimated selection dates for Parent Resident Visa queue
items.summary: New Zealand has provided estimated selection dates for Parent Resident Visa applicants waiting under the queue system. This update gives applicants an indication of when their applications may be processed under the current queue arrangement.

items.title: Dubai introduces new online service to simplify tourist visa process
items.summary: Dubai has launched a new online service making tourist visas easier to obtain for travellers. The updated system aims to streamline the application process for visitors planning trips to Dubai.

items.title: US green card applications face new tax scrutiny over unpaid dues
items.summary: US green card applications are now facing increased tax scrutiny, with unpaid tax dues potentially affecting approval decisions and future citizenship applications. Immigration lawyers warn that tax compliance has become a critical factor in the green card assessment process.

items.title: UK Budget introduces visa changes requiring 4 critical checks
items.summary: The UK Budget has introduced visa changes that require applicants to complete four critical checks. These new requirements affect various visa categories and applicants need to be aware of the additional verification steps in the application process.

items.title: UK student visa rules to change: Indians must show up to Rs 18 lakh for living expenses
items.summary: The UK is changing student visa rules, requiring Indian applicants to demonstrate financial capacity of up to Rs 18 lakh to cover living expenses. This represents a change in the financial requirements for Indian students planning to study in the United Kingdom.

items.title: Canada's new express entry rules could put Indian applicants at a disadvantage
items.summary: Canada's new express entry rules may reportedly disadvantage Indian applicants in the immigration process. The changes to the express entry system could affect how Indian candidates are assessed or selected for permanent residence through this pathway.

items.title: US green card lottery 2027: Court blocks reopening of diversity visa programme
items.summary: A court has blocked the reopening of the US Diversity Visa programme for 2027. This affects applicants who were hoping to participate in the green card lottery, which provides a pathway to US permanent residence through a random selection process.

items.title: Australia expands biometric requirements for Indian visa applicants
items.summary: Australia has expanded biometric requirements for visa applicants in India. Indian applicants will now need to provide additional biometric data as part of the visa application process. The new rules affect various visa categories for those applying from India.

items.title: Court blocks reopening of US Diversity Visa lottery programme for 2027
items.summary: A court has blocked the reopening of the Diversity Visa programme for 2027. This ruling affects applicants who were hoping for another opportunity to participate in the US Green Card lottery, and they may face longer waiting periods.

items.title: Australia expands biometric requirements for Indian visa applicants
items.summary: Australia has expanded biometric requirements for visa applicants from India. The new rules affect who must provide biometric data when applying for Australian visas. The changes outline what has been modified in the application process for Indian nationals.

items.title: Canada imposes fines up to CAD 1.5 million under tightened immigration rules
items.summary: Canada has tightened immigration rules and introduced fines of up to CAD 1.5 million for employers. The new regulations have implications for both employers hiring foreign workers and those seeking employment-based immigration to Canada through employer sponsorship.

items.title: UK student visa financial requirement increases from November 30
items.summary: The UK is raising the financial requirement for student visa applicants effective November 30. Applicants will need to demonstrate higher funds to cover their living expenses while studying in the UK. This change affects all new student visa applications.

items.title: Canada tightens immigration rules, imposes fines up to CAD 1.5 million
items.summary: Canada has tightened immigration rules and introduced fines of up to CAD 1.5 million. The changes have implications for employers and those involved in Canada's immigration system, representing a significant enforcement measure.

items.title: Canada tightens immigration rules with fines up to CAD 1.5 million for employers
items.summary: Canada has tightened immigration regulations and introduced penalties of up to CAD 1.5 million for employers. The new rules have implications for both employers hiring foreign workers and individuals seeking work opportunities in Canada.

items.title: UK student visa financial requirement increases from November 30
items.summary: The UK is raising the financial requirement for student visa applicants effective November 30. Prospective students will need to show higher maintenance funds to qualify for their student visas under the updated regulations.

items.title: India-New Zealand trade deal brings visa changes for Indian students
items.summary: The India-New Zealand trade deal has resulted in visa changes for Indian students. The agreement affects studying and working opportunities abroad in New Zealand, with new provisions for Indian nationals seeking education and employment there.

items.title: US green card sponsorship rules under review
items.summary: US green card sponsorship rules are currently under review, with potential changes on the horizon. The review could result in modifications to how sponsorship works for those seeking permanent residence in the United States.

items.title: New Zealand expands business visitor and specialist work visa eligibility
items.summary: New Zealand has expanded business visitor visa rules and specialist work visa eligibility for foreign professionals. The changes broaden the categories of workers and business visitors who can apply for these visa types in New Zealand.

items.title: Australia introduces new biometric requirements for Indian visa applicants
items.summary: Australia has introduced new biometric data collection rules for Indian visa applicants. The High Commission has clarified which categories of applicants will need to comply with the updated requirements that affect the visa application process.

items.title: UK work visa applications drop 43%, student visas fall 19%
items.summary: Latest figures show UK work visa applications have fallen by 43 percent while student visa applications have dropped by 19 percent. The data reflects recent trends in visa applications to the United Kingdom across different categories.

items.title: Australia restricts onshore student visa applications for Indian students in 2026
items.summary: Australia has introduced restrictions on onshore student visa applications for Indian students under new 2026 rules. The changes affect students who wish to apply for or switch to student visas while already in Australia.

items.title: New Zealand visa changes for Indian students under India-New Zealand trade deal
items.summary: The India-New Zealand trade deal brings visa changes affecting Indian students. The agreement has implications for both studying and working opportunities in New Zealand for Indian nationals seeking to go abroad.

items.title: Australia tightens student visa rules with 5 key changes
items.summary: Australia has tightened its student visa rules with five significant changes that Indian students must understand before applying to study abroad. The new regulations affect the application process and requirements for prospective international students from India.

items.title: US Green Card fees and application process changing in November
items.summary: The United States is implementing new fees and changes to the Green Card application process starting in November. Applicants for permanent residency will need to be aware of the updated requirements and costs for their applications.

items.title: Australia expands biometric data rules for Indians applying for visas
items.summary: Australia has expanded its biometric collection programme for visa applicants in India. Indian applicants will now need to provide fingerprints and facial images as part of a new process when applying for Australian visas.

items.title: US green card backlog: Indian EB-2 and EB-3 applicants face eight-year disadvantage
items.summary: Indian applicants in the EB-2 and EB-3 employment-based green card categories face an eight-year disadvantage compared to Chinese nationals due to backlog issues. The disparity highlights ongoing challenges in the US permanent residency system.

items.title: November Visa Bulletin: Green card dates advance for Indian family applicants
items.summary: The November Visa Bulletin shows forward movement in priority dates for Indian applicants in family-based green card categories. The advancement indicates progress for those waiting to sponsor or join family members in the United States.

items.title: Australia expands biometric collection programme to visa applicants in India
items.summary: Australia has expanded its biometric collection programme to include visa applicants in India. The new requirements mean Indian applicants will need to provide biometric data as part of their visa application process.

items.title: Indian EB-2 and EB-3 applicants face eight-year disadvantage in green card backlog
items.summary: Indian applicants in the EB-2 and EB-3 employment-based green card categories face an eight-year disadvantage compared to other nationalities. The backlog continues to create significant delays for Indian workers seeking permanent residency in the United States.

items.title: US EB-3 green card advances 21 days for Indians, EB-2 shows no movement
items.summary: The US green card wait for Indians shows mixed progress. The EB-3 employment category has advanced by 21 days, while the EB-2 category shows no movement in the latest update.

items.title: Indian visa applicants to provide fingerprints and facial images under new rules
items.summary: Under Australia's new rules, Indian visa applicants are required to provide fingerprints and facial images. The biometric requirements are part of expanded security measures for visa processing from India.

items.title: New visa rules for Australian students may force some to apply from overseas
items.summary: New visa rules for Australian students may require some international students to submit their applications from outside Australia rather than from within the country. The changes could affect application strategies for prospective students.

items.title: USCIS filing deadline rules changed from October 23 for visa and green card applicants
items.summary: Changes to USCIS filing deadline rules took effect from October 23, affecting visa and green card applicants. The updated rules modify how filing deadlines are calculated and applied for immigration applications.

items.title: US ends automatic work permit extensions for H-4 spouses
items.summary: The United States has scrapped automatic work permit extensions for H-4 visa holders, who are spouses of H-1B workers. The change also introduces tighter scrutiny of visa renewals, affecting families of Indian professionals working in America.

items.title: November visa bulletin shows selective progress for Indian green card seekers
items.summary: The November 2026 US visa bulletin shows selective progress for Indian applicants seeking employment-based green cards. Some categories have moved forward while others remain unchanged, affecting the timeline for permanent residency applications from India.

items.title: Australia tightens visa rules from October 31 with stricter character checks
items.summary: Australia is implementing tougher visa rules starting October 31, including stricter character checks for applicants. The changes will affect visa refusal and cancellation decisions, making it harder for some applicants to qualify for Australian visas.

items.title: India EB-2 green card date stalls for second consecutive month
items.summary: The priority date for Indian EB-2 employment-based green card applicants has remained stuck for the second month in a row. This continued stagnation means no forward movement for Indian professionals waiting in this category for permanent residency.

items.title: November bulletin shows big movement for Indian family-sponsored green cards
items.summary: The November visa bulletin reports significant forward movement for Indian applicants in family-sponsored green card categories. This progress will allow more Indians waiting to sponsor family members to move closer to receiving their permanent residency.

items.title: Indian student arrivals to US drop 39% amid stricter visa screening
items.summary: The United States has seen a 39 percent decline in student arrivals from India, reportedly linked to stricter visa screening procedures. The drop reflects tougher scrutiny being applied to Indian student visa applications by US authorities.

items.title: November visa bulletin: India EB-3 advances, EB-1 and EB-2 unchanged
items.summary: The November 2026 US visa bulletin shows the EB-3 employment category for Indian applicants has moved forward, while EB-1 and EB-2 categories remain unchanged. This affects the waiting time for Indians seeking green cards through different employment preferences.

items.title: High visa refusals for South Asian students despite Australia welcoming rhetoric
items.summary: Despite Australia stating it wants international students, South Asian families are experiencing high student visa refusal rates that contradict this message. The gap between official policy statements and actual visa outcomes is creating confusion for applicants from the region.

items.title: Australian student visa applications may need offshore lodgement
items.summary: Australian student visa applications may require offshore lodgement, meaning applicants would need to submit their applications from outside Australia. This reported change could affect how and where Indian students apply for their Australian study visas.

items.title: Indian students' US study plans hit by visa delays and stricter screening
items.summary: Indian students planning to study in the United States are facing challenges due to visa processing delays and increased screening measures. These stricter procedures are affecting timelines and creating uncertainty for prospective students seeking US student visas.

items.title: Australia to tighten visa rules from October 31 with tougher character checks
items.summary: Australia will implement stricter visa rules starting October 31, introducing tougher character checks for applicants. The changes will affect visa refusal and cancellation procedures, making the screening process more rigorous for those applying to enter or remain in Australia.
